title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
description: Find the minimum cost to reach the top of the floor, where you can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time.
pseudocode:
1: let n = cost.length
2: let dp = new Array(n)
3: dp[0] = cost[0]
4: dp[1] = cost[1]
5: for i = 2 to n - 1:
6:   dp[i] = cost[i] + Math.min(dp[i-1], dp[i-2])
7: return Math.min(dp[n-1], dp[n-2])

steps.note: Set base case: cost to start at index 0 is 10
Set base case: cost to start at index 1 is 15
Calculate min cost for index 2: 20 + min(10, 15) = 30
Return min of last two values: min(15, 30) = 15
